d:
Unprecedented scenes unfolded outside Delhi Police Headquarters on 2 November, as hundreds of policemen took to the streets in protest. The trigger? The transfer of ACP Manasvi Vashistha and Shahdara SHO Arun Kumar after a scuffle between policemen and lawyers.
It was an uncanny sight — the very men tasked with keeping the streets in order had taken to them in protest.
But Delhi had seen this before. On 22 June 1979, around 1,700 CRPF jawans gathered at the Jharoda Kalan Group Centre on the city's outskirts.
